description_html:
Summary

TAVI CRM's currency settings (Settings › Company Settings › Currencies) compared with Zoho CRM (Setup › Company Settings › Currencies). Both were checked live on 17 Nov 2026: TAVI on NDC-Staging, and Zoho in a test org where a currency was added, edited, used on a deal and deactivated. This list replaces the earlier one, which was based on two screenshots.

Correction: the earlier version said both products read the exchange rate the same way. They don't; see G5.

Environment

  • TAVI CRM: staging-crm.taviportal.com, tenant NDC-Staging, account ndc-staging-owner
  • Zoho CRM (reference): test org, checked live in Edge
  • Date: 17 Nov 2026

Missing functions

#FunctionZoho CRM (live)TAVI CRM now
G1Code or symbolCode/Symbol is a dropdown (for Euro: € or EUR).Symbol is a free-text box (up to 8 characters).
G2Automatic exchange rateUpdate Type: Automatic (the default; rates from Open Exchange Rates, updated every 30 minutes) or Manual.Manual rate only.
G3Number formatFormat section: Symbol Position (Before/After Value), Digit Separators (1,234,567.89 / 1.234.567,89 / 1 234 567.89 / 1 234 567,89 / 12,34,567.89), Decimal Places (0, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6) and a live Preview. Defaults follow the currency (Euro: € 1.234.567,89). Records show amounts in that format.No format options. Amounts always show as 1,000.00.
G4Home currency formatThe home currency has its own Edit with the same Format options (code/symbol, position, separators, decimals, preview).Not available.
G5Exchange rate directionWritten as one unit of the home currency in the other currency: "1 EGP = € 0.0175".Written the other way: "How many EGP one EUR is worth" (1 EUR = 50 EGP). Needs a decision, because rates copied from Zoho would be inverted.
G6Currencies listSearch Currency box; columns Currency Name (link), Format, Update Type, Exchange Rate (with info icon), Last Modified By with date; All Status filter (Active / Inactive); status toggle per row.Columns Currency, Symbol, Exchange rate, Status, plus edit / activate / delete icons. No search, no status filter, no Format / Update Type / Last Modified By.
G7Currency detail, history and trendClicking a currency opens a view with Info, Exchange Rate Trends (a chart) and Logs, e.g. "Exchange Rate was updated from 0.0175 to 0.02 by …" and "Euro - EUR was added by …".No detail view, no rate history, no trend.
G8Exchange Rate PreferencesA second tab with: "Allow users to refresh the exchange rate of records" (a refresh icon on each record updates its rate to the current one) and "Auto update the exchange rate of records" per module (Leads, Accounts, Deals, Tasks, Quotes, Sales Orders, Purchase Orders, Invoices, Campaigns, Vendors, Cases, Solutions) when the record is edited.Not available.
G9WarningsBefore the first extra currency: the currency and exchange rate fields will be added to the modules; an added currency can only be deactivated, not deleted; report filters comparing currency fields across modules stop working. Before deactivating: it can't be used for new records, users' preferred currency and create-record actions fall back to the home currency, auto update stops.No warnings.
G10Confirm the home currency once"Once you confirm your home currency, you cannot change it later." After confirming, Edit on the home currency changes only its format.No confirm step and no lock (see NDC-3101).

Already the same as Zoho

  • Rate 0 or negative is refused; Save is disabled while the rate is empty.
  • A record keeps the rate it was saved with when the rate changes in Settings.
  • Records show the amount in their currency plus the home value ("$ 1,000.00 ≈ E£ 50,000.00").
  • A deactivated currency can't be picked for new records; existing records keep it.
  • The home currency can't be added again as an extra currency; duplicate codes are refused.

Related bugs found in the same check

Filed separately: record currency not linked to Settings, Create Deal currency field and $ symbol, deleting a used currency, add-currency validation. Home currency: NDC-3101.

Not checked

  • Whether picking an Account sets the deal currency in TAVI (Zoho does: an EGP account switched a € 1,000 deal to EGP 57,142.86).
  • Who can manage currencies (profile permission), reports across currencies, TAVI audit log entries for currency changes.

Evidence

Two annotated images attached: the Add currency dialog (G1–G3), and the list, logs and rate preferences (G6–G8).
